answer: Twelve strangers must agree before the name goes on the roll. Mountain guide certification with alpine association attestation is their verdict: three-year training, 100 guided ascents, rescue exam, annual re-assessment. The saffron is the jury — people with no stake in the outcome, paid by the court, keeping their own notes. Bribing one juror buys one vote; a hundred fake names need a hundred juries, and the ocean is the first jury's price: twelve careers, twelve pensions, twelve reputations, all wagered on a stranger. The glacier is the court record, which anyone may read.
